```{r, libraries, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(fixest)
```

```{r,load-data, message=FALSE, results='hide', warning=FALSE}
incidents_path <- here::here("data", "Police_station_closure", "Data_Tables_LGA_Criminal_Incidents_Year_Ending_March_2026_0.xlsx")
offences_path  <- here::here("data", "Police_station_closure", "Data_Tables_LGA_Recorded_Offences_Year_Ending_March_2026_0.xlsx")

excel_sheets(incidents_path)
excel_sheets(offences_path)

read_excel(incidents_path, sheet = 1, n_max = 10, col_names = FALSE)

incidents_raw <- read_excel(incidents_path, sheet = "Table 01", skip = 1)
offences_raw  <- read_excel(offences_path, sheet = "Table 01", skip = 1)

closures <- read_csv(here::here("data", "Police_station_closure", "station_closures.csv"))%>%
  select(-treatment_month)
```

```{r, cleaning}
exclude_lgas <- c("Total", "Victoria", "Unincorporated Vic")

incidents_clean <- incidents_raw %>%
  rename(
    year                = 1,
    month               = 2,
    police_service_area = 3,
    lga                 = 4,
    incidents_recorded  = 5,
    rate_per_100k       = 6) %>%
  filter(!lga %in% exclude_lgas)

offences_clean <- offences_raw %>%
  rename(
    year                = 1,
    month               = 2,
    police_service_area = 3,
    lga                 = 4,
    offence_count       = 5,
    rate_per_100k       = 6) %>%
  filter(
    !lga %in% exclude_lgas,
    police_service_area != "Justice Institutions and Immigration Facilities")

```
 
```{r, build-panel}
treatment <- closures %>%
  group_by(lga_csa_name) %>%
  slice_min(treatment_year_csa) %>%
  distinct(lga_csa_name, treatment_year_csa) %>%
  rename(lga = lga_csa_name)

panel <- incidents_clean %>%
  left_join(treatment, by = "lga") %>%
  mutate(
    treated = if_else(!is.na(treatment_year_csa), 1L, 0L),
    post    = if_else(year >= 2024, 1L, 0L),
    did     = treated * post)
```
